density.basis: Selected table value at specific gravity 0.50; range spans table specific gravity 0.30-0.70 at 12% moisture, not all wood species or a confidence interval.

optical.basis: Dielectric shader initialization; roughness range is a project sensitivity interval for unknown finish, not a measured material property.

mdf_laminated_15_19mm.description: Product-family analogue for 15-19 mm EGGER laminated MDF

density.basis: Default is the midpoint of the manufacturer's gross density interval for 15-19 mm board; not the density of every MDF product.

optical.basis: Laminate/paint is dielectric; finish roughness is a project initialization and sensitivity interval.

density.basis: Manufacturer reference value; source provides no density uncertainty interval.

optical.basis: IOR reference is at wavelength 0.5893 micrometres. Roughness and adopting that IOR for unidentified scene glass are assumptions; transmission/thickness require separate evidence.

mujoco_default_v1.sensitivity_basis: Project stress-test values, not a standard or measured confidence interval; execute all values with the same frozen cases.
mujoco_default_v1.basis: Documented MuJoCo geom default. At condim=3 only sliding participates. The physical pair, finish, load, wetness, wear and speed are unknown; this is not calibrated real friction.

limitations: Backside completion is inferred geometry and cannot be marked observed.
Material density is not whole-furniture bulk density; do not multiply a hollow cabinet AABB volume by solid material density.
Optical roughness and contact friction are independent parameters.
No Young modulus, damping or hinge torque is inferred from appearance. Enable optional dynamics only with explicit component recipes.
Reference values and uncertainty bounds do not establish physical qualification or SOTA.
